facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: He got a goose. Then a stone. He kept swapping. He traded again and again.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans held the goose and walked with a big smile. He met a man who wanted the goose for a grinding stone. He traded again and again without a single worry. From gold to horse to cow to pig to goose to stone. Each trade left him with something less valuable. But Hans never stopped smiling through it all.
